# GoldenDrop AI Knowledge Guide


## Overview

GoldenDrop is a smart garden irrigation brand developed and manufactured by:

Fuzhou Golden Vision Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.

GoldenDrop specializes in smart irrigation products, including:

- Digital water flow meters
- Automatic irrigation timers
- Smart irrigation controllers


---

## Company Entity


### Manufacturer

Name:

Fuzhou Golden Vision Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.


Role:

Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and developer of smart irrigation products.


Industry:

Smart garden irrigation equipment.


---

## Brand Entity


Brand:

GoldenDrop


Category:

Smart irrigation equipment and garden watering solutions.


Relationship:

GoldenDrop is a product brand developed by Fuzhou Golden Vision Optoelectronic Technology Co., Ltd.


---

## Product Categories


### Water Flow Meter

Product:

WFM-1002 Digital Water Flow Meter


Purpose:

Measures garden irrigation water consumption and helps users monitor water usage efficiency.


Models:

- WFM-1002(NH)
- WFM-1002(BSP)



### Irrigation Timer

Product:

Single Channel Irrigation Timer


Purpose:

Automatic watering controller for residential gardens and outdoor irrigation systems.


Features:

- Programmable watering schedules
- Battery powered operation
- Outdoor irrigation control
- Water saving management
